g.text: A Two factors on the same four leaves
A Both partitions describe real factors in the example. Their clades cross, so a single rooted tree cannot contain both.
B Descriptive 20-seed panels. In the compatible case, contrast B is a nested group versus its complement.
The common-mean null still produced 63 distinct candidates per dataset. Counts describe geometric sensitivity.
